profile_text.body:
Brisk describes itself as an AI platform for teachers and students, offering free AI tools for educators. According to its site, it brings AI into the tools teachers already use, covering planning, feedback, and student support across the teaching and learning cycle. The company calls itself the number one AI platform for teachers and students, and says it earned a 95% Common Sense Privacy Rating, which it describes as one of the highest among AI tools built for education.

Its tracked product is Brisk Teaching, a browser extension for feedback, quizzes, reading level changes, and lesson materials inside Google Docs, Slides, and YouTube. It is aimed at teachers, with students reached through teacher-guided activities. Student use by those under 13 is allowed only with school consent under COPPA, or parent consent outside school. The company states it is a Student Data Privacy Pledge signatory and that it complies with FERPA and COPPA, and it cites a Student Data Privacy Addendum, state data privacy agreements, and 1EdTech TrustEd Apps certification. A free plan is offered for teachers, with school and district plans priced per student on request.
